description: The pts-gating invariant, the single most bug-prone client behavior. Speaking events arrive over the WS near-instantly, but the player's playback head lags the latest appended fragment by 0.5-1.5s. A conforming client MUST fire its idle<->speaking UI transition when playbackTime >= pts, in event order, NOT on event receipt. Each scenario feeds `events` (with arrival order) against a `playback` currentTime progression; the client must reproduce `expectedFires` exactly.

scenarios.name: basic_start_stop_with_lag
scenarios.comment: Events arrive ~1s before the playhead reaches their pts. Fire is gated on currentTime.

scenarios.name: both_events_already_passed
scenarios.comment: If the playhead is already past both pts by the time we sample, both fire in order on the first tick.

scenarios.name: legacy_no_pts_fires_immediately
scenarios.comment: Pre-2026-05 workers omit pts. A conforming client falls back to firing on receipt (currentTime of the tick it was received on).
